description: This file defines a Java class 'ActivateClientCommandHandler' responsible for handling the 'activate client' command within the Fineract platform. It implements the 'NewCommandSourceHandler' interface and uses 'ClientWritePlatformService' to activate a client when processing a command.

classes.name: ActivateClientCommandHandler
classes.description: A service component that processes activation commands for clients. It uses dependency injection to access client writing services and executes activation within a transactional context.

methods.name: ActivateClientCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the ClientWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming command to activate a client by delegating to the client write platform service and returning the result.
